comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-show-points.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1705): Sketch1 (F1) on XY with two lines, (-20, -15) to (20, -15) and (-20, 15) to (20, 15), a lone point at (-10, 5) and two free points that frame the view's fit at (-40, -30) and (40, 30).
Sketch2 (F2, mitcad#1764) on XY in the top left corner, inside Sketch1's frame and away from where the pointer goes: a line (-38, 22) to (-32, 22) and a lone point at (-35, 27).
